card.name: Radiochemical purity testing procedures
card.fires_on: Small words, digits and symbols inside radiopharmaceutical quality-control instructions (radiochemical purity, TLC strips, chromatography), and sometimes 'by' before an analytical method.

modes.label: Linking words before a method
modes.description: 'by' or 'the' right after 'determined' or 'measured' where an analytical method is about to be named.
modes.example: The radiochemical purity was determined<< by>> the following method. 2.4

modes.label: Numbers and symbols in purity specs
modes.description: Digits, spaces or % signs in radiolabel names, gauge ranges and percent-purity formulas.

card.writes: It pushes toward chromatography and synthesis/decomposition terms and away from large-number words like million and billion.
card.plain: It lights up in lab-method text about testing the purity of radioactive drugs by chromatography.
